name: SalSon Logistics - Houston TX
type: Drayage Terminal / Truck & Trailer Parking Yard

fieldNotes.truckGate: 8357 Liberty Rd is the 'Outpost' / 'Secure Trailer Lots' commercial truck-parking yard — a fully fenced 16-acre lot. 2021 Street View shows metal-panel perimeter fencing with a gravel driveway gap; the yard is gated.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the gate. Outpost truck-parking yards operate self-service with app/keypad access, so remoteGs is true. Flagged uncertain — 2021 imagery is the most recent Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: No dock-door warehouse. The site is an open dirt/gravel truck and trailer parking yard with only a small office/support structure. LogiCore lists SalSon-Houston dock doors as 'No'.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 16-acre yard rated for 500 truck/trailer spaces, packed with rows of parked trailers; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Vast open gravel area with ample room for additional lanes / bypass at the entry.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~16 acres per the Outpost / LoopNet listing for 8357 Liberty Rd.
fieldNotes.facilityNature: SalSon uses this third-party Outpost truck-parking yard as its Houston drayage trailer-pool / staging yard; it is not a SalSon-built warehouse.
